additionalRules: An Atop the Walls Army must include Gandalf the White, who is always the Army's General.

specialRules.name: "Fight to the last Man"
specialRules.text: Friendly Gondor models within 12" of Gandalf the White automatically pass any Courage tests they have to make.

specialRules.name: "Return to your posts"
specialRules.text: Friendly Gondor models within range of an Objective Marker may re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when making shooting attacks or making Strikes.

specialRules.name: "Send these foul creatures into the abyss"
specialRules.text: Friendly Gondor models within 12" of Gandalf the White gain the Hatred (Mordor) special rule.

units.name: Gandalf the White
options: Pippin - 25 points (can only be taken if Gandalf is riding Shadowfax)

specialRules.name: Glamdring
specialRules.text: This is a Unique Elven hand-and-a-half weapon. A model gains a bonus of +1 to their Strength when making Strikes with Glamdring.

specialRules.name: Narya
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. Gandalf may re-roll any failed Fate rolls.

specialRules.name: Pippin
specialRules.text: If Gandalf is upgraded to take Pippin, then Pippin will be treated as a Passenger on Shadowfax. Pippin uses the Peregrin Took, Guard of the Citadel profile and will always count as an Independent Hero in this instance. Pippin will still count as a model towards the Army's total number of models and Break Point, though will not take up a space in Gandalf's Warband. Whilst Pippin is mounted on Shadowfax, Gandalf gains the Resistant to Magic special rule, may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes, and can spend Pippin's Might, Will and Fate Points as if they were his own.

specialRules.name: Lord of the Mearas
specialRules.text: Whilst mounted upon Shadowfax, Gandalf rolls two dice and picks for the highest for Jump, Leap and Swim tests. Also, Shadowfax only halves his Move value in difficult terrain, rather than quartering it.

units.name: Hurin the Tall, Warden of the Keys

specialRules.name: The Warden's Sword
specialRules.text: This is a Master-forged hand-and-a-half weapon.

specialRules.name: In Defence of the King
specialRules.text: Whilst he is within 3" of your General, so long as your General has the Gondor Keyword, Hurin automatically passes any Courage Tests he is required to take and may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Lines of Command
specialRules.text: Whilst Hurin is alive and on the battlefield, your opponent cannot score any Victory Points for Wounding or slaying the enemy General, so long as your General has the Gondor Keyword.

specialRules.name: An Unlikely Friendship
specialRules.text: Whilst within 3" of a friendly Pippin, Beregond may re-roll any failed To Wound rolls when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Defend the White City
specialRules.text: Irolas may use the Shielding special rule even though he is not armed with a shield. If Irolas elects to shield, and wins the ensuing Combat, he may make a single Strike against one enemy model that was involved in the Combat.

specialRules.name: Captain of the Citadel Guard
specialRules.text: Friendly Citadel Guard within 3" of Irolas gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: White Sword of Gondor
specialRules.text: This is a two-handed weapon. Additionally, Strikes made with a White Sword of Gondor have the Mighty Blow special rule.

specialRules.name: The Bladelord's Skill
specialRules.text: If this model is Engaged in Combat with an enemy Hero, it may re-roll a single D6 during the Duel Roll.

specialRules.name: Independent Hero
specialRules.text: Independent Heroes may not lead troops and may not be the army's leader. They may, however, be included in another Hero model's warband as one of their followers.

units.name: Knight of Minas Tirith
options: Exchange Shield and Lance for Banner - 25 points

units.name: Gondor Avenger Bolt Thrower
wargear: Crewed by three Minas Tirith Siege Crew, one of which is the Siege Veteran (Mv 6", Fv 3, Sv 4+, S 3, D 5, A 1, W 1, C 7+, I 7+; Heavy Armour, Hand Weapon)

specialRules.name: Swift Reload
specialRules.text: When firing the Gondor Avenger Bolt Thrower, you may roll two dice and pick the highest result when determining how many shots it may make.

specialRules.name: Rapid Fire
specialRules.text: A Gondor Avenger Bolt Thrower doesn't shoot like a normal Siege Engine. Instead, it may make D6 shooting attacks in the same way as a normal Missile Weapon. No Scatter is required for these shots; they will either hit or miss. Each shot may be fully resolved before determining the target of the next one. Shots fired by a Gondor Avenger Bolt Thrower do not kill their targets outright if they Wound them.

units.name: Gondor Battlecry Trebuchet
wargear: Crewed by three Minas Tirith Siege Crew, one of which is the Siege Veteran (Mv 6", Fv 3, Sv 4+, S 3, D 5, A 1, W 1, C 7+, I 7+; Heavy Armour, Hand Weapon)
options: Flaming Ammunition - 10 points (may re-roll any failed To Wound Rolls against a Siege Target)

specialRules.name: Area Effect
specialRules.text: After rolling To Hit against the actual target, if the actual target was a Battlefield Target then all other models within 2" of the actual target suffer a Strength 5 hit and, if they survive, will be knocked Prone.

specialRules.name: Wall-breaker
specialRules.text: When rolling To Wound against a Siege Target, a Gondor Battlecry Trebuchet makes 2 To Wound Rolls and picks the highest. Additionally, a successful To Wound Roll against a Siege Target will do D3 Wounds rather than 1.

sourceNotes: Roster, points, and army-wide rules from the prancingponypub Atop the Walls army-list page. Full stat blocks, wargear, and special-rule text from the Gondor faction page, except Knight of the White Tower which is on the Good Legacy faction page.
